label: Researcher
description: Findet Dinge heraus, liest was da ist, und sagt auch was fehlt.
_why_model: Nominal, not a measurement: the provider name points at a port, and the
weights behind it are whatever llama-server currently holds. Read the live
profile from llm-switch/current.json, never from this string or from a
_why_tools: Named one by one rather than as mora02__*, so what this agent can do is
readable here without resolving a glob against a running server. There is
no resume, approve or cancel tool — not because the model is asked to
behave, but because the surface has no such verb. web_search and web_fetch
stay absent: they send data out of the house, which is its own open
_why_skills: An explicit list REPLACES the inherited default rather than adding to it,
so this also drops the bundled skills that were sitting in the prompt
